integrity: All general statements use the explicit equivariant contiguity and quotient proof. Finite checks are diagnostic. Residual risk of prior unindexed equivariant results; no external scientific verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns inherited automorphism subgroups of the ordinary Mycielski construction; no claim about all automorphisms of constructed graph, generalized higher-level Mycielskians, or independent-point persistence.
title: An equivariant suspension theorem for independence complexes of Mycielski graphs
